title: The Eye of Magnus
description: The final quest of the College of Winterhold questline. After recovering the Staff of Magnus, the player must breach the magical barrier around the College, confront Ancano in the Hall of the Elements, and defeat him by using the Staff on the Eye of Magnus. With Ancano defeated, the Psijic Order removes the Eye and the player is named the new Arch-Mage.

base_facts: I am a professor at the College of Winterhold.
Mirabelle Ervine sacrificed herself so others could escape the College.
The Staff of Magnus can dissipate the Eye's barrier.
Using the Staff on the Eye when it is open will close it and sever Ancano's connection.

ENTER_COLLEGE: The magical barrier around the College has been breached using the Staff of Magnus.
DEFEAT_ANCANO: Ancano has been defeated but the Eye of Magnus is still dangerously active.
SPEAK_QUARANIR: The Psijic Order has taken the Eye of Magnus away. I have named the new Arch-Mage and given them the key and robes.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have affirmed the new Arch-Mage and given them the key to the Arch-Mage's Quarters and the Archmage's Robes.
I have taken on the role of Master Wizard of the College following Mirabelle's death.
The Psijic Order has safely removed the Eye of Magnus from the College.
I will greet the new Arch-Mage with the respect their new position demands.

base_facts: I am an agent of the Thalmor embedded at the College of Winterhold.
I have merged my power with the Eye of Magnus and become nearly invincible.

REACH_HALL: I have harnessed the Eye's power. No one can stop me now.

base_facts: I am a monk of the Psijic Order.
The world is not ready for the power of the Eye of Magnus.

SPEAK_QUARANIR: The Psijic Order will safeguard the Eye. You have proven worthy and are now the Arch-Mage of the College.

beats.comment: Player uses the Staff of Magnus to breach the barrier around the College after learning of Mirabelle's death.
Player reaches the Hall of the Elements and confronts Ancano, who claims unstoppable power from the Eye.
Player defeats Ancano by using the Staff on the Eye to close it, making him vulnerable, then attacking. Tolfdir is paralyzed during the fight.

keywords: use the staff on the eye

beats.comment: After defeating Ancano, the Eye is still active. Player asks Tolfdir what to do next.
Quaranir of the Psijic Order appears, declares the player the new Arch-Mage, and the Order removes the Eye of Magnus.
Quest completes. Player is named Arch-Mage, receives the Archmage's Robes and key to the Arch-Mage's Quarters.
